nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a compact Hausdorff space, let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $\varphi \in C(X, \mathbb{K})$ and let $\mu \in \mathbb{K}$. Then $\mu$ is an eigenvalue of the multiplication operator $M_\varphi f = \varphi f$ on $C(X, \mathbb{K})$ if and only if the level set $\varphi^{-1}(\{\mu\})$ has nonempty interior.
nodes.title: Eigenvalues of a multiplication operator

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a compact topological space, let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, and let $\varphi \in C(X, \mathbb{K})$. The multiplication operator $M_\varphi f = \varphi f$ is invertible in the algebra of bounded linear operators on $C(X, \mathbb{K})$ if and only if $\varphi(x) \neq 0$ for every $x \in X$.
nodes.title: Invertibility of a multiplication operator

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a compact topological space, let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, and let $\mu \in \mathbb{K}$. The multiplication operator on $C(X, \mathbb{K})$ by the constant function with value $\mu$ equals $\mu$ times the identity operator.
nodes.title: Multiplication by a constant on continuous functions

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a compact topological space, let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, and let $C(X, \mathbb{K})$ be the Banach algebra of continuous functions $X \to \mathbb{K}$ with the supremum norm. For $\varphi \in C(X, \mathbb{K})$, the multiplication operator $M_\varphi$ is the bounded linear operator on $C(X, \mathbb{K})$ given by $M_\varphi f = \varphi f$.
nodes.title: The multiplication operator on continuous functions

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a compact topological space, let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, and let $\varphi \in C(X, \mathbb{K})$. The spectrum of the multiplication operator $M_\varphi f = \varphi f$, as an element of the algebra of bounded linear operators on $C(X, \mathbb{K})$, is the range $\varphi(X)$ of $\varphi$.
nodes.title: Spectrum of a multiplication operator
